title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode14 Saki's Resolve

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Starting today, we can start practicing together!
This is gonna be so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where were you thinking of having our first gig?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our first...gig?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't tell me you haven't thought that far. What are we going to be rehearsing for if not a gig?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Er... Our first show can be at...the school festival!
Kind of clichéd, but I dig that kind of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh well, I guess that's fine for starters.
We've got to take this band stuff seriously, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But we only just got back together.
Can't we take it easy for now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. Once I let you get your foot in the door, your lack of discipline will affect everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh... You're being so harsh on me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice to see you two going at it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we forgot to tell Miku and Luka that our band got bigger.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! They had a hand in making this happen, so we should go and thank them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've been practicing with them in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! They have been enormously helpful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe Hona would like to come along, too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's...not likely.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She still hasn't gotten over her junior high school trauma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What trauma? What happened to her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know the details. Just that her classmates had been ignoring her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! But she's so nice, she makes friends wherever she goes. Why would they do that to her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't know. Whenever I tried to talk to her, she brushed me off saying not to worry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were still talking to her back then?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A bit. She looked really sad, so I wanted to find out why, but she always just clammed up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you notice how she was depressed all the time?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, seems she couldn't stand being excluded, so now she follows her classmates around like a dog.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, you're being mean.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It peeves me that she changed so much. She used to be kind to everyone, but assertive. When someone was being mean, she'd call them out on it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But now? It's like she doesn't have a mind of her own anymore. If her classmates told her to bark and roll over, she would.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It makes me so mad to see her like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I spoke with her recently.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's heartbreaking...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What she's doing is turning her back on us and her other friends because she can't face up to those bullies. That's not a solution!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You have to understand that she's scared.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Besides, she's the gentle type. She worries about upsetting people around her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, right. But she didn't care about upsetting you or Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...Look, I'm sorry.
I just can't understand why Honami's being like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Although I guess I can't really talk...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona's always been super kind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, remember when that hat you really liked fell into the river and Honami jumped in to get it for you? Her clothes got all wet, but she didn't hesitate for a moment!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: ...Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She puts others' needs before her own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see now what we should do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should give up on getting her to join the band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, are you serious?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. This will be an act of kindness from me to her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh, I guess I kinda sound full of myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I don't want to cause her any more trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could tell her that I'll always be her friend, no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wasn't there for her when she needed me before, so it would just sound like an empty promise.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry... I told you about the bullying because I thought we could still do something now. I didn't mean to make you feel bad about what happened...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No worries, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, Hona is now getting along with her classmates.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't think it would be right for us to throw a spanner in the works because we think our friendship should matter more to her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have to respect her choices.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Moving on, we should get some practice done!
Let's go over to Miku's place!
